invariant.portable_principle: Debugging evidence, quality-perimeter truth, architectural signal, pattern briefing, and debt prioritization can produce durable host artifacts without interpreting the host application's source language.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: A locked TypeScript 5.9.3 host supplies source roots, a real direct tsc contract failure, plan/ADR/pattern context, detector evidence, and cached debt audits while copied skills produce report-level outcomes.
explicit_non_goals: TypeScript parser, compiler API, module-resolution, or framework claim
Node, React, Express, ORM, queue-provider, or package-manager support
Source mutation, automated remediation, guard generation, or a TypeScript-specific variant
A generic copied quality runtime or recreation of host spec/decision authorities

reference_repairs.issue: The documented evidence gate was repository-only and imported root _lib.
reference_repairs.repair: Added a selected-skill check-only evidence gate that reads sibling frontmatter and the scan manifest with stdlib only.

reference_repairs.issue: The documented scanner path reached back into .claude/skills in a checkout.
reference_repairs.repair: Documented SKILL_DIR and run the copied local scanner in the final-outcome test.

reference_repairs.issue: Its selected path required uninstalled repository registry/audit/log scripts.
reference_repairs.repair: Use explicit host-owned cached JSON/JSONL inputs and write inputs.md provenance; do not recreate those authorities.

syntax: The fixture contains TypeScript source only as realistic host context.
Only the diagnose reproducer invokes tsc to prove a concrete contract mismatch.
type_system: npm run typecheck proves the normal host baseline.
npx --no-install tsc --noEmit --strict diagnostics/retry-contract.ts produces TS2322 for the diagnosis loop.
module_resolution: NodeNext resolution is supplied by the locked host but none of the five skill outcomes analyzes imports.
runtime: The two executable paths use copied local scripts with host python3.
The three prompt-led paths read host-owned documents or retained cache data.
framework: None; package metadata does not imply a Node web framework.

tooling.selected: Pinned skills@1.5.19 stock copy install, locked TypeScript 5.9.3 host, final-artifact pytest oracle, copied local diagnose/perimeter executable checks.

rejected_alternatives.typescript_variants: The accepted outcomes are report/briefing/queue judgments, not TypeScript semantics.
rejected_alternatives.copied_registry_runtime: Duplicating specs.py, decisions.py, or logging scripts would recreate host authorities and violate the selected-core boundary.
rejected_alternatives.shared_launcher: No demonstrated second consumer needs an execution platform; prompt-led artifacts and two family-local scripts are sufficient.

tooling.closure_mode: Five separate one-skill installs; the test asserts the installed directory contains exactly that one selected skill.

inputs: one copied installed skill per replay
structured_outputs: diagnose evidence manifest plus diagnosis, reproduction, root-cause, verification, and cleanup reports
triage-debt inputs.md provenance and ranked queue
must_fire: TS2322 boundary mismatch is reproducible and diagnose evidence validates
the uncovered src/typescript matrix cell is visible under --fail-on-gap
gut-check separates raw and ADR-contradicted smells
teach-pattern cites host pattern, decision, exemplar, and counter-example
triage-debt chooses standardize-and-enforce for six repeated omnibus findings
must_not_fire: A language:any detector pretending to cover TypeScript

commands: $REPO_ROOT/.venv/bin/python scripts/skill_meta.py lint --quiet (OK — 76 skills, 76 declaring new contract)
pre-commit suite on commit 3aef3e1 (passed, including find-skill-artifact-drift)

known_false_positives: a valid host typecheck is not evidence that the separate queue-adapter contract is valid
a repeated six-finding band is one missing standard, not six isolated repair tickets
known_false_negatives: Prompt-led artifacts cannot prove a fresh agent's independent judgment; D6 remains open.
Cached triage cannot determine whether a host's omitted audit input is clean.

generalized: Selected prompt-led skills can be proved through separate stock installation, raw natural tasks, durable artifact contracts, and source fingerprints.
A local check-only helper is acceptable when it is the smallest explicit selected closure and does not reconstruct an uninstalled authority.
A host-owned cache can be an honest aggregator input when provenance and missing axes are recorded.
did_not_generalize: The root repository's generic evidence gate and its full init/show behavior
Host registry generation, decision/spec auditing, and effectiveness logging
Framework architecture and any TypeScript semantic-analysis claim

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: A generic prompt-artifact launcher or copied host quality runtime.
evidence: The two executable closures have different input contracts; the remaining three are prompt-only.
No second accepted consumer demonstrates a shared runtime need.
reuse_decision.owner: serial integrator only after an accepted second consumer

rust.idiomatic_representation: locked crate plus host ADR/report context

go.idiomatic_representation: locked Go module plus host quality artifacts

java_or_kotlin.idiomatic_representation: locked source set plus host quality artifacts

csharp.idiomatic_representation: locked project plus host quality artifacts

ruby.idiomatic_representation: locked application plus host quality artifacts

install_steps: Run one pinned stock --copy install for the desired quality skill.
Provide the host's own quality context or retained cache; no selected skill downloads a runtime.
agent_confusions: Source-tree-looking script paths are not a copied-install contract.
A cached audit input must be declared unavailable when absent, never interpreted as zero debt.
repeated_work: One locked host is reused, but tasks and installed skills remain isolated.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: Run the deferred D6 fresh-agent replay before updating the shared coverage disposition.

residual_risks: D6 is not executed in this lane.
Diagnose proves a seam and intentionally does not authorize a source fix.
Triage cache producer behavior remains a host responsibility.
Gut-check and teach-pattern results depend on the supplied host documents being current.

next_decision.recommendation: After D6, promote exactly these five skills to validated-neutral for their tested artifact outcomes; do not add TypeScript variants or shared runtime.
next_decision.rationale: Separate stock installs, source fingerprints, concrete final artifacts, and explicit closure repairs prove a useful language-independent core without metadata-only relabeling.
blockers: Serial integration of router/catalog/tracker state outside this lane
